description.summary: Temporal disjunction causes the subject’s own perceptions to lag moments behind actual events
description.value: Temporal disjunction causes the subject’s own perceptions to lag moments behind actual events. The creature suffers a -2 penalty to his AC, attack rolls and saving throws, is considered to be flat-footed at all times and suffers a 20% miss chance on all his attacks. Targeted spells suffer a 50% chance of failure but area effect spells can be cast normally. This spell may be removed with a successful dispel but it is otherwise permanent.
